v1_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given available resources with sufficient capacity, when all requests are made, then the function returns True
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given the available capacity is 'CPU' 10, when the total requests for 'CPU' are 5, then the function returns True
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given the available capacity is 'RAM' 30, when the total requests for 'RAM' are 10, 15, and 10, then the function returns False
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given the capacity for 'disk' is exactly 5.0, when two requests are made for 2.5 each, then the function returns True
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given the available resource only includes 'CPU', when a request asks for 'GPU', then the function returns False
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given the stored capacity is defined as a negative number, when the function is called, then an error is raised

v1_human_g2_constraints.c_1: Resource requests are positive, matching total offered in the sum check request
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Resource capacities cannot be exceeded under any circumstances
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_3: All required resources must exist in the available network list, otherwise the allocation is infeasible
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_4: Each request is assumed to be properly formatted as a dictionary with integer & float values to compute
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_5: Resource capacity and request amounts must be valid numeric values
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_6: Negative values for capacities or specified amounts are not allowed

v1_human_g2_goal: This system checks whether you have enough resources available to satisfy a set of requests. It returns a boolean value indicating if a valid allocation exists.
v1_human_g2_input: - requests: List of tuples (resource_id, amount) - a dictionary mapping each resource to the amount requested, with possible values (capacity), (capacity) must be valid or non-negative. - available: List of available resources as a dictionary mapping each resource to its current available amount. All requested resources must fall in the available dictionary.
v1_human_g2_output: True if all requests can be satisfied without exceeding available capacity, False otherwise. If at least one request cannot be satisfied without exceeding available capacity, should return False.
